◉ LUCAS SPECIFICATION — v0.1
LUCAS is the persistent user-interface/project-state layer. It does not own specialist intelligence.
Core objects: Project, Goal, Asset, Assistant, Job, Step, Decision, Deliverable, Version, Checkpoint, Export.
Novice actions: NEW PROJECT / OPEN PROJECT / ADD FILES / ADD FOLDER / ADD ASSETS / GOAL / START / CONTINUE / REVIEW / RESULTS / EXPORT.
Approval gates: destructive operations, publication/release, external side effects, material scope/identity changes, secrets/credentials, irreversible migrations.
Resume: reconstruct from project manifest + append-only events + latest verified checkpoint.
